2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return; // no canvas found
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 400);
7:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 300);
8: 
9:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20;
10:   const LANE_Y = [H * 0.25, H * 0.75]; // two lanes (up/down)
11:   let player = { x: 50, y: LANE_Y[0], lane: 0 };
12: 
13:   const obstacles = [];
14:   // background stars for neon effect
15:   const stars = [];
16:   for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
17:     stars.push({
18:       x: Math.random() * W,
19:       y: Math.random() * H,
20:       size: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
21:       alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.3,
22:     });
23:   }
24:   // player trail positions
25:   const trail = [];
26:   const OBSTACLE_W = 30;
27:   const OBSTACLE_H = H * 0.4;
28:   let speed = 2;
29:   let spawnTimer = 0;
30:   let score = 0;
31:   let running = true;
32: 
33:   const toggleLane = () => {
34:     player.lane = 1 - player.lane;
35:     player.y = LANE_Y[player.lane];
36:   };
37:   window.addEventListener('click', toggleLane);
38:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.code === 'Space') toggleLane(); });
39: 
40:   const drawNeon = (x, y, w, h, color, radius = 0) => {
41:   ctx.fillStyle = color;
42:   ctx.shadowColor = color;
43:   ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
44:   if (radius > 0) {
45:     ctx.beginPath();
46:     ctx.moveTo(x + radius, y);
47:     ctx.lineTo(x + w - radius, y);
48:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + radius);
49:     ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - radius);
50:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - radius, y + h);
51:     ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y + h);
52:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - radius);
53:     ctx.lineTo(x, y + radius);
54:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + radius, y);
55:     ctx.closePath();
56:     ctx.fill();
57:   } else {
58:     ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
59:   }
60:   ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
61: };  function spawnObstacle() {
62:     const top = Math.random() < 0.5; // from top or bottom
63:     const y = top ? 0 : H - OBSTACLE_H;
64:     obstacles.push({ x: W, y, w: OBSTACLE_W, h: OBSTACLE_H });
65:   }
66: 
67:   function update(dt) {
68:     // move obstacles
69:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
70:       const o = obstacles[i];
71:       o.x -= speed;
72:       // collision
73:       if (
74:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
75:         player.x + PLAYER_SIZE > o.x &&
76:         player.y < o.y + o.h &&
77:         player.y + PLAYER_SIZE > o.y
78:       ) {
79:         running = false;
80:       }
81:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
82:     }
83:     // spawn logic
84:     spawnTimer -= dt;
85:     if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
86:       spawnObstacle();
87:       spawnTimer = 1500 / speed; // faster spawns as speed rises
88:     }
89:     // increase difficulty
90:     speed += 0.001;
91:     score += dt * 0.001;
92:   }
93: 
94:   function render() {
95:     // clear canvas
96:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
97:     // draw gradient neon background
98:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
99:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
100:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#003');
101:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#001');
102:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
103:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
104:     // moving tunnel lines for depth effect
105:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.08)';
106:     for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
107:       const lineX = (i * 30 + (performance.now() / 6)) % W;
108:       ctx.beginPath();
109:       ctx.moveTo(lineX, 0);
110:       ctx.lineTo(lineX, H);
111:       ctx.stroke();
112:     }
113:     // player with slight radius for smoother look
114:     drawNeon(player.x, player.y, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE, '#0ff', 4);
115:     // obstacles with rounded corners
116:     obstacles.forEach(o => drawNeon(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h, '#f0f', 5));
117:     // score
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
119:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
120:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
121:     if (!running) {
122:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
123:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
124:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f88';
125:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
126:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
127:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
128:     }
129:   }
130: 
131:   let last = performance.now();
132:   function loop(now) {
133:     const dt = now - last;
134:     last = now;
135:     if (running) update(dt);
136:     render();
137:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
138:   }
139:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
140: })();

(End of file - total 140 lines)
